notes.title: Update: v1.0.3
notes.notes:
v1.0.3
2020-12-31

 Massive FPS fix for the Orc boss fight. (Read about it over in the dev log.)
 Level experience requirements increased.
From: 0, 440, 910, 1410, 1940, 2500, 3090, 3710, 4360, 5040 experience.
To: 0, 695, 1610, 2865, 4580, 6875, 9870, 13685, 18440, 24255 experience.
 Add guidance tip to unlock second checkpoint stone.
 Fix bug where some creatures would not call their neighbors for help.

Scene 3

 New elite spider creature.
 Increased size of scene.
 Introduce torch mechanic during level to demonstrate before boss encounter.
 Improve arena torch particle state switching. Smoother transition.

Minor

 Increase standard spider attack speed.
 Further adjustments to notification vertical positioning to fit level notices and checkpoint info cleanly.
 Fix some inconsistent shadows on main entrance gates.


Spell Book (from v1.0.2)
The previous update was a "minor" update, so the header image wasn't very visible. Check it out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302666/5365ccac150872e94ccf47bfd1411f13deaee4ce.jpg

Added a Spell Book! Your spells will be automatically added to your bar if there is room, so it isn't mandatory to use. But, pressing "S" to open will allow you to drag the skills down to the skill bar in any order. Enjoy!

-Sarynth

notes.title: Small Update: v1.0.2
notes.notes:
v1.0.2
2020-12-30

Added a Spell Book!

  Added "S" hotkey to open the Spell Book.
  Added ability to drag spells from spell book to skill bar.

Added level requirement for spells.

  Spells now gained more slowly based on level.
  Spells added automatically on level up if there is room on the skill bar.
  Unlocked skills included in level up notification.

ESC key now closes checkpoint teleport menu.
Add remaining level entrance indicators.
Add a couple elite skeletons to first level.
Can now attack the corrupted crystal in first level. Plus, there are a few more.
Fix bug where sometimes the game could get stuck paused when toggling the menu.
Reduced Fire Rock damage from 51-66 down to 45-56 base damage. Increased cooldown from 3.5s to 4.0s.

Minor:

Removed some old spell data.
Adjusted "notification two" location to add more data to "notification one."
Created window manager to support in-game draggable windows (for spell book, etc.)
Remove excessive experience bar update loop.
Camera zoom should no longer trigger when the mouse is over an interface window. (Spell book, checkpoint teleport, etc.)
Clean up some edge cases where the guidance tool tip did not get cleaned up.

notes.notes:
v1.0.1
